title: Document multilingual copy-editing and localization on p.apyr.us (S)

comments.author: home
comments.text: Source for the p.apyr.us page: PPY-d0132d shipped (PR #1486, merged to develop, not released). docs/editorial-checks.md section 'Every check is in one language' covers per-language policies, the site languages setting and Spanish variant (es-419), refusal of languages without a Humanus pack, starter packs per language, and writing-guideline language overlays.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Serving docs for p.apyr.us: docs/multilingual-serving.md in the engine repo is the source (settings languages.prefixes/public/slugs, editions, hreflang, interface strings in strings/<tag>.json, Unicode addresses and the gated CloudFront/S3 checks). The p.apyr.us page should explain: each language at its own address with English unchanged, a page lists only languages it is really published in, Chinese addresses in Chinese characters, and a language goes public only when its interface words are complete.
